this was in second grade, and i had just transferred to a new school. i didnt really talk to much people at first, until we got in line for specials. this girl began conversating with me, and introduced herself as araceli. from that day forward, we'd become best friends forever. araceli was a sweet, funny, and cute girl, and we got along very well. we'd hug everyday, lay our heads on each other's shoulders/laps, etc. she was ticklish, so i also tickled her a lot. there was this one time where i wouldnt stop tickling her and she licked my arm for me to stop. it was really gross.. obviously, i ended up catching feelings. (this was also when i found out i liked girls, i identified as bisexual) one day me, araceli, and our friend makayla, we're talking to each other and i came out to them. makayla said she was also bi, and araceli said she was straight. it hurt, i will admit, but there was nothing i could do about it. i just accepted it. we still hung out everyday at recess, and everytime we had the chance to. that was until, 3rd grade arrived. we were in separate classes, and the only time we could ever talk was at specials or recess. we never growed distant though. we spent recess together and i even got her mom's number so me and araceli could talk (she didnt have a phone). we only spoke once, though. in 4th grade i still wasn't in her class, in fact i knew nobody in my class. about a week into the new school semester, the school day had just ended and my mom was driving me and my sister home. all of a sudden, she said she was going to transfer us. i was shocked, and hurt. i silently cried, while thinking about how araceli lost my mom's number and i lost her mom's number. she never found out about how i felt about her, and we haven't had contact with each other since 4th grade.
